meta.name: claude-reflect
meta.description:
Execute self-learning system that captures corrections during sessions and syncs them to CLAUDE.md.
Use when discussing learnings, corrections, or when the user mentions remembering something.
Trigger with phrases like "remember this", "don't forget", "use X not Y", or "actually...".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动记录纠错并同步长期记忆
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常纠正助手的回答,希望它不再重复犯错
copy.tagline_en: Automatically record corrections and sync to long-term memory.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often correct your assistant and want it to avoid repeating mistakes.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会自动留意你的纠正（如“用 X 别用 Y”“其实我是想说…”），把要点记入待办队列；当你输入 /reflect 时，它会列出这些要点请你确认，再写入全局或项目记忆文件 CLAUDE.md，供以后参考。
howto.when: 当讨论学到的东西、纠正，或用户提到要记住某事时触发；具体如说“记住这个”“别忘了”“用 X 别用 Y”等会自动捕获，运行 /reflect 则进入人工确认。

say.text: 记住：以后推理任务用 gpt-5.1，不用 gpt-5。
不，用 X 而不是 Y，别忘了这个。
say.note: 纠正会被自动捕获，留待 /reflect 时确认写入记忆。

say.text: 实际上，我的意思是先做测试再写代码。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude auto-detects your corrections (e.g., "use X not Y", "actually...") and queues them. Running /reflect lists the items for confirmation, then writes accepted ones to global or project CLAUDE.md for future sessions.
howto.when_en: It triggers when discussing learnings, corrections, or remembering something; phrases like "remember this", "don't forget", or "use X not Y" are auto-captured, and /reflect starts manual confirmation.

say_en.text: Remember: use gpt-5.1 for reasoning tasks, not gpt-5.
say_en.note: It gets queued for confirmation via /reflect later.

say_en.text: No, use X instead of Y; don't forget this.
say_en.note: The correction is captured for review at /reflect.

say_en.text: Actually, I meant run tests before writing code.
